entities.name: Jarga
entities.description: Massive troll in Vraska's entourage, loyal to her.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker who led a coup to take over the Golgari Swarm.

entities.name: Jarad vod Savo
entities.description: Golgari leader overthrown by Vraska's coup.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose leadership Vraska took over.

events.summary: During Vraska's coup, Jarga smashes through the front door of Jarad's chambers.
events.quote: Jarga was instrumental in breaching Jarad's chambers

events.summary: Vraska becomes the new leader of the Golgari; Jarga remains loyal to her.
events.quote: Jarga remained loyal to Vraska and continued to serve under her rule

relations.quote: Jarga remained loyal to Vraska and continued to serve under her rule
